name: czrecoil_frame_start_campaign_mode_2
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuStartCampaignMode2 dispatches campaign mode id 3 through RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4312b0 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
